chapter: Liberty Band, marriage and the Depression
title: Seven-piece band, work for white people, and Celestin and Robichaux
summary: Vincent names the men in his seven-piece band, says most work was for white people, and describes Celestin taking jobs and how he came to join John Robichaux.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

And who was in your band? Blunt. Key Boy. Fetter Burberry. Murray's. Duran. Flying Fetter. And myself. Uh… Duran. Uh… There were seven pieces then. Ask him how long Duran played with his band. And he asked us, will we get a good job, will we take John Robeshow? We told him, yeah. That's why we got John Robeshow. And John Robeshow asked us to John his band.
